newsitem.title: USA: Immunomedics, Mallinckrodt get EU ok for CEA-Scan.
newsitem.headline: Immunomedics, Mallinckrodt get EU ok for CEA-Scan.

text.p: Immunomedics Inc and Mallinckrodt Group Inc said Friday they received final clearance from the European Commission to market CEA-Scan.
The clearance allows the product to be marketed in all 15 European Union countries for the detection of colorectal cancer.
The product is already cleared for use in the United States.
Each year there are 175,000 new cases of colorectal cancer in Europe, and the disease is estimated to kill more than 100,000 Europeans annually, the companies said.

The companies said the CEA-Scan provides more information than standard diagnostic methods. They said compared with current methods, it identifies about 40 percent more patients who are operable for potential cure and about twice as many for whom surgical removal would be fruitless, saving them the suffering of surgery and the costs of the operation.
Mallinckrodt, based in St. Louis, is a human healthcare and chemical company serving specialty markets.
Immunomedics is a biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Morris Plains, N.J.
